name: Dağda Gün Doğumu
scene: Mountain peaks glow pink at sunrise beneath a golden sun, with pine trees framing a lake.
notes: Design sheet only. Mountains and sun use the rose/gold subject pair; sky, pine trees, shore and lake use the blue/teal background pair. Inspired by vitray_lighthouse.png and vitray_poppies.png, with mountain-contacts.webp as subject reference. Reviewed initial generation and regenerated once to improve flatness, pine tiers, junctions and white exterior. Remaining doubts: some four-way contacts remain in sky arcs and shoreline; sun panes remain adjacent gold and will need merging/recolouring; subtle fill variation remains. Target is 93–133 panes; raster connected-component estimate is 152 coloured regions >=250 pixels before tracing/merging, so simplification is still needed. No loose interior line ends apparent at review scale; sharp mountain and pine tips need downstream sliver checks. This is not a geometry-audited or published game asset.
